title: More reliable Bedrock and combat interactions
summary: Bedrock item behaviour and several classic-combat interactions are now more consistent across inventories, hotbar changes, and sword blocking.
body:
- Bedrock fishing and custom-item fuel behaviour are more consistent with the Java server.
- Classic-combat cooldown and attack-range handling now follows hotbar and hand changes correctly.
- Off-hand inventory interactions no longer produce repeated compatibility errors.
- Sword blocking uses corrected Paper item data, including when items are displayed through chat or inventory plugins.
- These compatibility updates do not change your progression, inventory, statistics, or saved game data.
